forecaster_note: Enough short period NE wind wave around for some peaky waist to chest high surf at most spots. Light NW'lies and a clean wave, then NE'lies later and we'll need to shelter again — perhaps a late southerly wind change coming through. — Anthony Spinks, Surfline

wind.summary: Light NNW, mostly cross-shore — turns onshore NE by midday

shark.summary: No detections at Dee Why, Long Reef, Curl Curl or Manly — or anywhere on the Northern Beaches — in the last 24h. Nearest recent regional hit: a tagged White Shark ping at North Narrabeen (~33h ago, outside the 24h window). Feed is current (newest statewide ping ~1h old).

days.label: Today
days.note: Peaky, fun-sized NE wind swell keeps most spots playable this morning — light NW/cross winds now, turning onshore NE by midday. Get out early; Long Reef is rating best of the four right now.

dee-why.window: Best before ~10am while it's light and clean — onshore NE fills in through the arvo.

tip.label: Frontside peak
tip.text: NE angle wraps nicely into the Point — stay frontside on the rights, they'll edge out the backside lefts today.

long-reef.window: The pick this morning — best-rated of the four. Get there before the onshore fills in around midday.

tip.label: Today's pick
tip.text: Clean right-hand walls off the reef, frontside all the way — worth the drive today.

curl-curl.window: Peaky early, fades toward POOR by afternoon as the NE onshore builds.

tip.label: Beachie peaks
tip.text: Take either peak — backside lefts work fine here if Long Reef or the Point look crowded.

manly.window: More tucked from the NE angle — smaller but often stays cleaner a bit longer into the morning.

tip.label: Sheltered option
tip.text: Good fallback if the Point/Reef are crowded — expect smaller, softer walls.

days.label: Tomorrow
days.note: Nothing too exciting — head-high-plus at the exposed south corners but onshore and lumpy. Better bet is a small, clean wave tucked into sheltered corners from leftover NE windswell — best early before the onshore fills in, probably fun enough on a small wave or longboard.
